import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { UserItemService } from 'src/app/services/user-item.service'; import { NewItem } from 'src/app/models/new-item.model'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; @Component({ selector: 'app-view-all-items', templateUrl: './view-all-items.component.html', }) export class ViewAllItemsComponent implements OnInit { items: NewItem[] = []; constructor(private service: UserItemService, private router: Router) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.service.getAllItems().subscribe((data) => (this.items = data)); } viewDetails(id: number) { this.router.navigate(['/user/items/details', id]); } }
